subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, given the new authenticated microphone-audio RPC and privacy boundary?
rationale: The approach is more aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting a browser-to-Gateway audio transcription method is a product and security-boundary choice that code review cannot authorize by itself.

options.title: Continue after proof and fixes
options.body: Require a current-main port, the accessibility and docs-map fixes, and redacted real behavior proof before considering merge.

options.title: Pause behind the paired issue
options.body: Keep the feature issue and PR open while maintainers decide the Control UI dictation boundary and ownership.

options.title: Supersede with a fresh branch
options.body: If the old-surface branch is too stale, close or replace it with a narrow implementation against the current `ui/src/pages/chat` composer.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and fixes
recommendation.body: Require a current-main port, the accessibility and docs-map fixes, and redacted real behavior proof before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal from the prior server-side dictation implementation and is connected to the relevant Gateway/UI boundary.
